Description: All required fields present and correctly typed
Applies_To: DB01 DB02 DB03 DB04 DB05 DB06
Method: Compare column names and types to schema definition
Notes: First check — all downstream checks depend on correct structure

Description: No nulls in required fields
Applies_To: DB01 DB02 DB03 DB04 DB05 DB06
Method: COUNT null per required field
Notes: Required fields defined per-database in schema files; NULL in required field = critical failure

Description: No duplicate primary keys
Applies_To: DB01 DB02 DB03 DB04 DB05 DB06
Method: SELECT pk COUNT(*) GROUP BY pk HAVING COUNT > 1
Notes: Duplicate primary key = data integrity failure; investigate before any deletion

Description: All foreign keys resolve to parent records
Applies_To: DB01 DB02 DB03 DB04 DB05 DB06
Method: LEFT JOIN to parent table; flag unresolved records
Notes: Child record without parent = orphan; must resolve before publication. Order: validate LKPs first, then DB01, then child tables

Description: All coordinates within Nigeria bounds and not swapped
Applies_To: DB01 DB02 DB03 DB04 DB05 DB06
Method: Range check Lat 4.0–14.0 and Lon 2.5–15.0; swap detection
Notes: Out-of-bounds coordinate = critical failure; return to field for re-survey or correction

Description: Records spatially consistent with stated administrative unit
Applies_To: DB01 DB03 DB06 (point-in-polygon against G01/G02)
Method: GIS point-in-polygon after G01 and G02 built
Notes: Requires G01 and G02 to be CLEAN first; flag mismatches for field team review

Description: All dates are valid; no future dates; dates in logical sequence
Applies_To: DB01 DB02 DB03 DB04 DB05 DB06
Method: Date format check; range check; sequence check where applicable
Notes: Invalid or future dates = critical failure; sequence failures (e.g. child survey before parent) = warning

Description: Coded fields contain only allowed values; conditional fields populated when required
Applies_To: DB01 DB02 DB03 DB04 DB05 DB06
Method: Value set check; conditional logic checks
Notes: Flag invalid codes and unfilled conditional fields (e.g. Flood_Damage_Description missing when Flood_Damage=Yes); not automatic publication block but must be resolved

Description: Numeric fields within plausible bounds
Applies_To: DB01 DB02 DB03 DB04 DB05 DB06
Method: Range check per field as defined in schema
Notes: Implausible values flagged for expert review; not automatic block unless extreme (e.g. GPS >100m accuracy)

Description: NULL used for not-recorded values; zero reserved for confirmed zero
Applies_To: DB01 DB02 DB03 DB04 DB05 DB06
Method: Check fields where 0 may falsely represent missing data
Notes: Critical for loss fields (Flood_Losses_NGN, Erosion_Losses_NGN), generation fields (Generation_MWh), and rainfall (Rainfall_mm)

Description: No restricted data in non-restricted outputs
Applies_To: DB02 G04
Method: Column check on any output derived from DB02; PRIV07 sign-off
Notes: Household_ID, Latitude, Longitude must never appear in Level 1 or Level 2 publication outputs

Description: Source documented in SOURCE_REGISTER.csv for all external datasets
Applies_To: DB04 DB05 G01–G08
Method: Cross-check SOURCE_REGISTER.csv
Notes: Every external dataset must have an SRC entry before it enters the CLEAN layer

Description: Data_Version populated; VERSION_LOG.csv updated
Applies_To: DB01 DB02 DB03 DB04 DB05 DB06
Method: Null check on Data_Version; check VERSION_LOG entry exists
Notes: Version tracking is mandatory for reproducibility; not a publication blocker but required before VALIDATED status

Description: Enumerator completion rate and response pattern check (household surveys)
Applies_To: DB02
Method: Group stats by Enumerator_ID; flag outliers
Notes: Flag enumerators with <80% completion or anomalous patterns for supervisor review

Description: No impossible jumps between consecutive temporal records
Applies_To: DB04 DB05
Method: Sequential comparison per facility/station
Notes: Month-on-month jumps > 2 SD flagged; extreme events documented separately; not automatic block

Description: Values consistent across databases for same entity
Applies_To: DB01 + DB03/DB04/DB06
Method: Cross-check shared fields (coordinates; state/LGA codes) between parent and child records
Notes: Flag cases where DB03/DB06 coordinates are >5km from parent DB01 community; DB04 coordinates differ from G07

Description: All coded fields resolve to lookup tables
Applies_To: DB01 DB02 DB03 DB04 DB05 DB06
Method: LEFT JOIN to each relevant LKP_ file
Notes: Separate from Q04 (parent tables); covers all LKP_ lookup files

Description: Derived spatial fields populated for all records
Applies_To: DB01 DB03 DB06
Method: Check HYBAS_ID / Community_ID / River_Distance_m populated after integration scripts
Notes: Run after GIS layers are CLEAN; flag records where join failed

Description: All records used in analysis have Consent_Given = Yes
Applies_To: DB02
Method: Filter check
Notes: Records with Consent_Given = No must be quarantined before any analysis step

Description: GIS layer geometry coordinates match database Latitude/Longitude
Method: Compare geom X/Y to Lat/Lon fields; flag discrepancy > 0.00001 degrees
Notes: Run after GIS layers rebuilt from database; ensures DB and GIS are in sync
